tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark: deep violet-black that sits under the brand purple; Light: the brand's own #F9F9F9.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, chat panels on bg.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Raised cards, 'other' chat bubbles, hovered rows, inputs inside cards.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: phone screen backgrounds, code, sunken trays.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card borders (decorative, not meaning-bearing).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (outline buttons, chips, inputs): 3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, timestamps on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Icons, disabled text and placeholder hints only (3:1 on bg/surface); never body copy.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand violet. Primary buttons, 'self' chat bubbles, active tab, selected states. Fill only in dark (use accent for violet text).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover / pressed fill for primary.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind primary content: selected rows, feature panels, tag fills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and primary-hover.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Lavender. Secondary buttons, avatars, illustration fields, large display accents (24px+ on bg).

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text on secondary fills.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Sakura pink. Reactions, highlights, the playful accent; tertiary buttons; as text it reads on dark bg only.

tokens.name: tertiary-soft
tokens.usage: Pink-tinted panels: reaction trays, creator highlights.

tokens.name: on-tertiary
tokens.usage: Text on tertiary fills.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Violet as TEXT: links, eyebrows, usernames in chat, on bg/surface/surface-raised.

tokens.name: accent-pink
tokens.usage: Pink as TEXT: reaction counts, 'new' labels, on bg/surface/surface-raised.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: LIVE badge fill and the live dot. Always paired with the word LIVE.

tokens.name: on-live
tokens.usage: Text on live.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations ('You're on the list'), online dots; as text on bg/surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px; 3:1+ on every ground in its theme.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Always-dark section ground (Airing this week, phone screens) in both themes.

tokens.name: stage-raised
tokens.usage: Cards on stage.

tokens.name: stage-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and outline chips on stage.

tokens.name: on-stage
tokens.usage: Text on stage and stage-raised.

tokens.name: on-stage-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on stage and stage-raised.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Brand white, fixed in both themes: inverted chips and buttons on stage.

families.sans: "Plus Jakarta Sans", "M PLUS Rounded 1c", system-ui, sans-serif
families.jp: "M PLUS Rounded 1c", "Plus Jakarta Sans", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-1
styles.usage: Desktop hero headline only (>=1024px). On mobile the hero steps down to display-2.

styles.name: display-2
styles.usage: Desktop section headlines; mobile hero (set 40px under 400px).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, room names, stat numbers.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Small card titles, list headers, nav wordmark fallback.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Chat in real time, post the long takes, plan the next watch-along.
styles.usage: Hero and section supporting copy: one or two short sentences.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Rooms open 15 minutes before the episode drops.

styles.name: jp-accent
styles.usage: Japanese reaction stamps and decorative kana (never sole carrier of meaning).

tokens.name: space-12

tokens.name: space-16

tokens.name: space-20

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding (tablet).

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Section padding (desktop).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chat bubble tail corner, tiny tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Avatars in squircle form, small thumbnails, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the waitlist panel.

tokens.name: radius-xl

tokens.name: radius-pill
